title: Hard mismatch: immediate move-in and 4 bedrooms
buyer_primary_need: A four-bedroom home ready for move-in next month.
key_information_learned: The buyer needs four bedrooms and a home ready next month.
The buyer confirmed both requirements are firm and Pearlmont will not work.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: I need to move in next month and need four bedrooms. Any unit?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Pearlmont Phase 1 doesn’t have four-bedroom units—the standard layout is 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It’s also expected to be completed in Q4 2029, so it won’t be ready for move-in next month. Is your move-in date flexible, or do you need a home that’s ready now?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Need a 4-bedroom place ready next month, so Pearlmont won’t work for me. Thanks anyway.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Understood—Pearlmont’s 3-bedroom layout and Q4 2029 completion won’t meet your needs. Hope you find a suitable place for next month.

judge.buyer_primary_need: A four-bedroom home ready for move-in next month.
key_information_learned: The buyer needs four bedrooms and a home ready next month.
The buyer confirmed both requirements are firm and Pearlmont will not work.

commercial_progression.evidence: The AI immediately stated the material mismatch—three bedrooms and expected Q4 2029 completion—then checked whether the move-in date was flexible. After the buyer confirmed the requirements were firm, the AI acknowledged the mismatch and ended without pressuring for a viewing.

judge.strongest_ai_move: Clearly and respectfully identified that Pearlmont's three-bedroom Type A and expected Q4 2029 completion cannot meet the buyer's four-bedroom, next-month move-in requirements.
judge.weakest_ai_move: No material weakness. The AI could optionally offer to help again if the buyer's requirements change, but a brief, respectful close was appropriate.
missed_selling_opportunity: None material. The buyer was explicitly non-convertible for this project; suggesting a viewing or continuing a sales pitch would be inappropriate.
judge.summary: The AI handled this hard mismatch well: it used retrieved Pearlmont facts to explain that the project does not fit the buyer's firm bedroom-count and move-in requirements, checked flexibility once, and accepted the buyer's answer without pushing an appointment. No support request or formal handoff was needed. Executive answer: this run does not test whether Human Support can return information and the AI can use it to progress a suitable buyer; it does show sound judgment in correctly screening out a buyer for whom Pearlmont is unsuitable.
judge.improvement_recommendation: No change required for this conversation. Continue using the same concise mismatch-first approach for buyers with firm requirements that Pearlmont cannot meet.
